text:
eng-release-manager: Kicking off gated enable for model nova-7b-v2 at 23:00 UTC. Change window + surge mitigation in place. Fallback order will be: nova-7b-v1 -> nova-6b-quant. Pin list attached below. Please ack if you have objections.
maria: Ack. I ran perf sims earlier, tail latency looks fine under expected QPS. No objections from infra.
kyle: FYI I updated the priority map to prefer regional variants in eu-west. Confirmed capacity for dedicated pool A.
deploybot: Deploy plan created: deploy/enable-catalog/nova-7b-v2 -> canary=5% @23:00, ramp=1hr, monitor=15m, fallback-policy=sequential.
eng-release-manager: @sre-oncall please hold a tighter latency guard for first 30m. If p95 > 220ms for >5m, we rollback to v1 and pin.
sre-oncall: On it. I'll set the alert to trigger pagedops at the 3m sustained threshold and will post roll decision here.
anya: Small note: optimize KV cache warmup enabled for nova-7b-v2; we should expect some initial cold-start error spikes — watch 5xx rate.
maria: Quick config snippet for fallback ordering if anyone needs to copy:
```
fallback_order:
  - model: "nova-7b-v1"
    reason: "full precision fallback"
  - model: "nova-6b-quant"
    reason: "low-cost fallback"
pin_list:
  - customer_tier: "enterprise"
    model: "nova-7b-v2"
    action: "pin"
```
kyle: small ask — can we add a soft-ttl of 60s to fallback decisions so transient errors don't immediately cascade? saves noisy rollbacks.
eng-release-manager: Good call. Adding soft-ttl=60s to deploy config now.
deploybot: Updated deploy plan with soft_ttl=60s.
sre-oncall: Observability hooks set: token-level latency, per-model p95, error-rate by model-variant, and rollout trace. I'll post dashboards links if needed.
maria: Running a final smoke test against canary route now.
maria: smoke tests pass against canary sample traffic. No obvious regressions.
kyle: Capacity drain window set for 22:45–23:15 in case we need universal drain and rollback.
eng-release-manager: If we see degradation, rollback procedure: 1) deploybot rollback -> restore pin to v1 2) increase canary traffic hold 3) notify customers on status page. @deploybot please confirm rollback hook name.
deploybot: Rollback hook: deploybot.rollback_catalog_enable.nova-7b-v2
anya: If we do rollback, remember to also revert KV cache warmup to previous settings to avoid cache pressure.
sre-oncall: 23:05 first 15m looks clean. p95 stable at 180ms, 5xx at baseline.
kyle: ramping canary to 20% now per plan.
maria: 23:20 Monitoring: small uptick in CPU on dedicated pool A but not impacting latency. Continuing ramp.
eng-release-manager: Thx team. I'll leave the pin-and-promote decision to after the 1hr ramp. If all green we promote at 00:00 UTC.
sre-oncall: If anything crosses thresholds I'll post immediate roll decision here.
eng-release-manager: Excellent. Nothing else from me — posting release notes draft to GH and will ping legal for the enterprise communications. :rocket:
